protocol.place_palm: nominal oracle palm for a cup centre at xy c = c + legacy palm_offset[:2] (sample_layouts' mapping); place palm = coaster + offset
protocol.oracle_rows: paths_v2.oracle_path on trials 0-9 (legacy-grasp xy, each trial's own handle yaw) through run_m3.run_one unchanged (build_path swapped); reachable = M3's rule (FK error at G and at P < 1 cm and < 10 deg, path max < 2 cm)
protocol.after_prelude: information only: per run, the largest FK position / orientation error over the phases other than 'prelude' (max_by_phase); 'below 2 cm' counts runs whose after-prelude maximum is < 2 cm (not a rule)
protocol.v2: paths_v2: M3's path, pause removed, approach split at i_pause, transport at its peak, each human segment re-timed rest to rest (D = D0 + 0.4 s, smoothstep speed ramps), geometry / warps / k unchanged

collision_oracle.method: M3 harness single-plan IK clip (standing_palm setup, one plan_path(base='plan', base_goal=_goal(G, R_G), return_fk=True)); frames from the prelude's last frame to the last frame with remaining path arc length to G > 1 cm; per frame: scene.reset (open hands, mug at its layout pose), set_robot_to_clip_frame, mj_forward, min mj_geomDistance from the 8 right-hand geoms to cup_geom and the cup_handle_* capsules; information only, never a gate
